# PR idempotence (reconcile)

When reconciling merged PRs, any PR number already recorded as a succeeded CompileRun is skipped (idempotent processing); the caller may request an expected PR and the reconcile will assert it was covered, raising CompileError if not.

Ensure each merged PR is processed exactly once and allow callers to verify that a particular PR was included in the reconcile.
